units.text: INT. OBSERVATORY DOME, COPPER-ROOFED - NIGHT
The great telescope has been dead for decades, a gutted whale of brass and glass pointing at a slot of stars.
Rain ticks against the copper.
The air smells of mouse and old oil.
NADEZHDA "NADIA" ORLOVA-SUTTON (40s) kneels on the iron floor with a tablet glowing in her hands.
She wears a lab coat over a wool jumper, and her hair is wet.
She types fast, then stops, then types again.
Beside her, RAFAEL TORRES-IBEKWE (30s) holds a flashlight in his teeth and a cable in each fist, feeding wire into the telescope's mouth.
He spits the flashlight into his palm.
Two minutes.
units.name: RAFAEL

units.text: Everyone stays quiet. Nothing on the radio.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: There is no one else.
She says it anyway, to the dome, to the ghosts of astronomers.
Rafael glances at her but says nothing.
Come on, come on, come on.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: He hauls himself up onto the telescope's housing and tightens a clamp.
She taps the tablet.
A green bar crawls across the screen.
Eighty percent?
units.name: RAFAEL

units.text: Seventy-eight.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: That's not eighty.
units.name: RAFAEL

units.text: Rafa, I know what it is.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: He climbs down, wipes his palms on his trousers.
Overhead, rain gathers force.
She does not look up.
He does.
Metal rings on the spiral stair outside.
Slowly, deliberately, someone is climbing.
Nadia.
units.name: RAFAEL

units.text: I hear it.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: He kills the flashlight.
The dome goes dark except for the glowing tablet and a thin blade of starlight.
Her thumb hovers over the screen.
The door at the foot of the stair swings open.
A figure fills it: INSPECTOR AUGUSTINE LEBLANC (60s, a long coat dripping rainwater, a lantern in one hand).
He sets the lantern on the floor and holds up both palms.
You'll want to finish that. I'm only here to watch.
units.name: AUGUSTINE

units.text: She looks at Rafael.
Rafael looks at her.
Neither lowers the cable.
Don't trust him.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Of course I don't.
units.name: RAFAEL

units.text: Ninety percent.
Ninety-five.
He stands very still, the way a man does in front of a dog he has not yet decided about.
When it's done, I'll walk you out. Not before.
units.name: AUGUSTINE

units.text: The bar fills.
The tablet chimes once.
Above them, the telescope shudders and, for the first time in forty years, begins to turn.
